text:
Type: round braided rug
Use: soft spot for play and sitting on the floor; kids room, nursery, playroom, bedroom
Style: contemporary, bohemian
Materials: braided fabric cord coiled in a tight spiral, flat weave
Colors: bright apple green, hot pink center
Shape: flat circle of coiled braid, bullseye pattern with a wide green ring around a pink middle, thin and light
Feel: playful, fresh, cheerful
Goes with: white or light wood furniture, colorful toys, bright accents; kids rooms and playful modern spaces

product.name: STICKAT
product.description: You can turn the rug over and use it longer, as it looks the same on both sides.
